payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over even i (2 to w) and even j (2 to h), adding (w+1-i)*(h+1-j) to count rhombus placements.
payload.rationale: The code performs a brute-force enumeration over possible rhombus sizes (diagonal half-lengths). It does not use recursion, bitmasks, branch-and-bound, graph search, or permutation generation. Search_backtracking is the closest among given options, though it's an overstatement.
